title: Austin Executive Session: City Manager Search
summary:
*   Austin officials convened for a special meeting primarily held in executive session.
*   Discussions focused on sensitive topics including potential land acquisitions and current legal matters.
*   A significant item on the agenda was the search and selection process for a new City Manager.
*   No final policy decisions or votes were taken during this meeting, which was dedicated to private deliberations.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - March 05, 1988 - 3:30 P.M THIRD FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM - MUNICIPAL
BUILDING Council Chambers. 307 VNfest Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor
Cooksey opened the special called meeting of the Council* noting the absence of
Councilmember Humphrey.
Mayor Cooksey announced it was 4:00 P.M. and that Council would go into executive session
pursuant to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated* to discuss matters of
land acquisition* litigation and for personnel matters. No final action* decision or vote
by the City Council vill be taken on any subject or matter unless specifically listed on
the agenda for this meeting.
1. Personnel Matters - Section 2* Paragraph g a. City Manager Search Council recessed for
executive session at 4:00 P.H. and adjourned their meeting at 6:45 P.M.
